text:
The abstract reports a broad review of nanofluid applications in machining, citing various nanofluid types (e.g., alumina, carbon nanotubes) and their performance gains, as well as discussing mechanisms, equipment, and mapping parameters to outcomes. It does not present or test a specific hypothesis involving hierarchically designed Al₂O₃‑Cu@TiO₂ hybrid nanoparticles, surface functionalization, real‑time sensor integration, or reinforcement‑learning optimization. The detailed, AI‑driven, multi‑modal MQL system described in the candidate hypothesis goes far beyond the scope and claims of the reviewed study. Therefore, the evidence does not support this candidate as the study’s main hypothesis.  

VERDICT: REJECT
